job.description: APM multi-metric job: transaction latency, throughput and failed-transaction count per service (workshop, fictional data).

detectors.detector_description: High mean transaction latency (us) for each service
Unusually low transaction throughput (count) for each service
High failed-transaction count for each service

script.source: if (doc.containsKey('event.outcome') && doc['event.outcome'].size() > 0 && doc['event.outcome'].value == 'failure') { emit(1); } else { emit(0); }

ui_path: Observability > Machine learning > Anomaly detection > Jobs > Create job > select data view 'APM (workshop)' (traces-apm-mlws) > Multi-metric. Add query 'processor.event : transaction'. Add metrics: Mean(transaction.duration.us), Count, Sum(mlws_failed); split field service.name; influencers service.name, transaction.name, host.name. Bucket span 15m. The failed-count metric Sum(mlws_failed) needs the mlws_failed runtime field, so finish in the Advanced wizard or use 'Convert to advanced job'. Enable model plot. Job ID mlws-apm-multimetric, group mlws. Start real-time.
teaches: One job with three detectors, each split by service.name, finds latency, throughput and failure anomalies for every service at once. A2 (latency x4 on orders-api), A1 (throughput drop on cart-api) and A4 (payments-gateway failed-transaction count via high_sum on the 0/1 mlws_failed flag) should surface. high_sum is used rather than high_mean because the mean of a 0/1 flag has huge per-record variance and hides a 0.8% to 27% spike. Also shows datafeed runtime_mappings, influencers, model plot and forecasting.
